page_title: ANG 1-0 TOU | Angers v Toulouse 08/02/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+6' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Toulouse.
90+4' Substitution. Louis Mouton will be replaced by Pierrick Capelle (Angers).
90+3' The game is interrupted now, Herve Koffi (Angers) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
90+1' Clement Turpin shows a yellow card to Lilian Raolisoa (Angers) for his blatant foul.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.

89' 1 - 0 Guillaume Restes is stranded way out of his goal after his team loses possession and Lilian Raolisoa (Angers) has the simplest of tasks to shoot the ball into an empty net from distance. It’s now 1:0.
89' Cristian Casseres (Toulouse) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
87' Mark McKenzie (Toulouse) has tested the patience of referee Clement Turpin and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
86' The corner is swung in but Angers can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
84' Angers keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
82' The resulting set piece from Toulouse is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
81' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Pape Demba departs the field of play to be replaced by Mario Sauer (Toulouse).
81' Carles Martinez has decided to make a change. Mark McKenzie (Toulouse) replaces Rafik Messali.
80' Clement Turpin shows a yellow card to Carlens Arcus (Angers) for his blatant foul.
79' Substitution. Prosper Peter (Angers) replaces Goduine Koyalipou.
76' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 8:11.
74' Carles Martinez has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jacen Russell-Rowe (Toulouse) replacing Santiago Hidalgo.
74' The substitution is prepared. Dayann Methalie (Toulouse) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Aron Donnum.
72' Toulouse hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
70' Yassine Belkhdim (Angers) expertly controls a neat clever pass inside the box, but his effort crashes against the right post! What an opportunity that was!
69' Branco van den Boomen (Angers) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
68' Santiago Hidalgo (Toulouse) makes an unfair challenge by holding his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball.
66' Alexandre Dujeux prepares a substitution. Amine Sbai is replaced by Lanroy Machine (Angers).
65' Clement Turpin blows his whistle and signals a foul after Santiago Hidalgo (Toulouse) brought his opponent down.
63' Emersonn comes off the pitch to be replaced by Julian Vignolo (Toulouse).
62' The ball is cleared after Yassine Belkhdim (Angers) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
60' A cross from Rafik Messali (Toulouse) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
58' Louis Mouton (Angers) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
57' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Pape Demba (Toulouse) was quite harsh and Clement Turpin didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
56' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 44:56.
54' Jacques Ekomie (Angers) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Clement Turpin had an easy-decision to make.
53' Pape Demba (Toulouse) creates space for himself on the edge of the box and smacks a hard shot towards the middle of the goal, but it's an easy save for Herve Koffi.
51' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Lilian Raolisoa (Angers).
49' Pape Demba (Toulouse) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
48' A corner kick by Toulouse is thwarted by the well prepared Herve Koffi (Angers).
48' Toulouse take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

48' Santiago Hidalgo (Toulouse) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Herve Koffi makes a comfortable save to stop the effort from flying into the middle of the goal. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Toulouse.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+1' Clement Turpin has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
43' Pape Demba (Toulouse) finds himself with a great opportunity! He unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, which whizzes just wide of the left post!
41' Yann Gboho (Toulouse) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot.
39' Branco van den Boomen (Angers) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, but his low effort is straight at Guillaume Restes.
37' Carlens Arcus (Angers) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
35' Emersonn (Toulouse) gets in a header from close range after a lofted pass, but the effort flies just over the bar.
33' Yann Gboho (Toulouse) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Clement Turpin has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
31' Rafik Messali (Toulouse) thinks that he is fouled by his opponent, but the referee deems him to be the one who commits a foul and awards a free kick to the other team.
30' The total number of attempts is 2:4.
27' The corner from Branco van den Boomen (Angers) is hurriedly cleared.
25' Cristian Casseres (Toulouse) trips an opposition player and Clement Turpin signals a foul.
23' Amine Sbai (Angers) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
21' Yann Gboho (Toulouse) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a strong shot towards goal, but his effort is denied by the well positioned keeper.

19' Emersonn (Toulouse) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went low towards the middle of the target, but Herve Koffi was alert and the score remained the same.
17' Goduine Koyalipou (Angers) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box after picking up a pass, but produces a poor effort that sails high over the bar.
15' The ball possession is 39:61.
13' Cristian Casseres (Toulouse) has a chance after receiving a pass. He measures his shot from the edge of the box but it sails just wide of the left post.
11' Toulouse are seeing far more of the ball now.
9' Santiago Hidalgo (Toulouse) meets a cross inside the box, but Herve Koffi wins the battle for the ball and the chance is gone.
7' Santiago Hidalgo (Toulouse) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
5' Emersonn (Toulouse) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it.
3' Toulouse are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Toulouse will have the kick-off.
Clement Turpin is the one to supervise the game today.
